title: In defense of persimmons
text:
Title: In defense of persimmons

In this tale, I am the baby. Those whole, dried persimmons, smashed to sweet, soft, flat, powdery pucks, have been one of
 my favorite snacks for as long as I can recall. Once, unable to find them where I live in Louisville, Ky, I carried a box in my luggage 
 from an H-Mart in Austin, Texas, like precious cargo. I rationed those dozen to stretch for months — I’m down to my last three.
